headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 13, 2026**
article:
The Detroit Tigers secured a shutout victory over the Cleveland Guardians, winning 3-0. Eduardo Valencia led the Tigers' offense with a home run and an RBI. In other action, the Cincinnati Reds rallied past the Chicago White Sox 9-8, with Eugenio Suárez leading the offense with a home run and 4 RBIs. The Pittsburgh Pirates cruised past the Miami Marlins in a dominant 13-1 victory, with Rafael Flores Jr. hitting 2 home runs and driving in 6 runs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries. Matt Chapman has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to an abdominal strain. Trevor McDonald was also transferred to the 60-day injured list with a right elbow strain. Garrett Whitlock has been placed on the 15-day injured list with right elbow inflammation. The Detroit Tigers have placed James Outman on the 7-day injured list with a concussion and Riley Greene on the 10-day injured list with a right hamstring strain. Endy Rodríguez has been placed on the 10-day injured list with left hip inflammation. Jake Bloss has been placed on the 60-day injured list, and Kyle Karros has been placed on the 7-day injured list with a concussion.

The Baltimore Orioles have acquired Harold Rivas in a trade involving the Boston Red Sox. The Kansas City Royals have also made a trade, acquiring Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Guardians 3-0**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a shutout victory over the Cleveland Guardians, winning 3-0. Eduardo Valencia led the Tigers' offense with a home run and an RBI.

top_news.title: **Reds Rally Past White Sox 9-8**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a thrilling 9-8 victory over the Chicago White Sox, with Eugenio Suárez leading the offense with a home run and 4 RBIs. Tejay Antone earned the win with a strong relief appearance, striking out 3 batters in 1 inning of work.

top_news.title: **Pirates Cruise Past Marlins in Dominant 13-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing win over the Miami Marlins, with a final score of 13-1. Rafael Flores Jr. led the Pirates' offense with a standout performance, hitting 2 home runs and driving in 6 runs.

top_news.title: **Mariners Take Down Yankees in Low-Scoring Affair**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners secured a 1-0 victory over the New York Yankees, with Logan Gilbert earning the win after pitching 6.0 innings with 7 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Matt Chapman Placed on 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: San Francisco Giants third baseman Matt Chapman has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to an abdominal strain. This move comes after he was initially placed on the 10-day injured list.

top_news.title: **Rivas Joins Orioles in Trade**
top_news.summary: Harold Rivas has been traded to the Baltimore Orioles as part of a deal involving the Boston Red Sox. The trade is related to the August 3 Adley Rutschman trade.
